title: MO. releases his recent single titled “Lifestyle”
htmlContent:
Chicago-based music star MO. is a talented singer and songwriter raised in Gambia, The homeland of his parents. The talented singer explores a wide range of sounds as his Gambian roots and experience as a first-generation American play a big part in his music style. These attributes are on full display in his recent song “Lifestyle.”

In his recent song, “Lifestyle,” MO. he talks about his hometown Dippakunda, Gambia, and the challenges they experienced while growing up. The vision and emotional feeling evoke everything, making people fall in love with music.
